edges: McTeague becomes infatuated with Trina while working on her teeth.
McTeague and Trina kiss and declare their love for each other.
McTeague and Trina's life together deteriorates as Trina becomes more miserly.
McTeague takes all of Trina's domestic savings and abandons her.
McTeague kills Marcus in a fight over Trina's $15,000.
McTeague is left handcuffed to Marcus's corpse in Death Valley.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Mrs Sieppe announces that McTeague and Trina are to marry.
Marcus claims he has been cheated out of money that would have been rightfully his if he had married Trina.

edges: Marcus hears of the murder and joins the hunt for McTeague.
